mira: FYI reproducing a JS SDK issue where prefetch + token refresh causes duplicate page fetches and a spike of 429s. Repro: sampleapp prefetch=3, concurrency=4, blast client. When a prefetch fetch gets a 401, the retry path replays the same page cursor before the refreshed token is applied. Logs: [fetch] page_token=abc123 -> [auth] 401 -> refresh -> [retry] fetch page_token=abc123 -> [api] 429. Gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/mira-paginate-repro
jason: what exact sdk version and sample config? pinging @sven in case middleware order bug.
mira: sdk-js 1.6.3, retry=default, prefetch=3. py-sdk doesn't show it (awaits refresh).
devx-bot: rate-limit-bot: detected spike -> 429s (service=api, window=1m, count=98) :warning:
sven: likely token-refresh race + prefetch. Two short fixes: 1) serialize refresh so inflight requests that hit 401 await the same refresh promise; 2) add per-page idempotency/dedupe server-side. Quick client pseudo: acquire a refreshLock before refresh and share the promise. Also consider tiny jitter before retrying a paginated page after 401 to let token propagate.
alejandra: file sdk-js bug (labels: sdk-js, backpressure, auth). add integration test that injects 401 mid-prefetch. Check go- and py-sdk parity and add entry to onboarding troubleshooting.
mira: I'll PR serialized-refresh + test and add optional flag paginator.awaitAuthOnPrefetch (default false) so users can opt in during onboarding. Will mention in release notes and sampleapp config.
ryan: thx. when PR merges, add a short note to onboarding: "If you see 429s on first-run, reduce prefetch or upgrade to SDK >= 1.6.4. Example: {prefetch:1, awaitAuthOnPrefetch:true}"
